sentence: This project studies how a symbiotic bacterium and a parasitoid wasp came to live together and how the bacterium's genes are lost over time.
This project sets up a shared service that gives technical and cybersecurity support to oceanographic research vessels.
This project builds a curriculum and a living lab that combine heating and air conditioning work with building automation systems.
This project studies how atoms at the surface of high entropy oxides are arranged and how that affects chemical reactions.
This project builds tools that use machine learning to improve chemical reactions and predict their outcomes.
This project builds a quantum sensor from superfluid helium and a nanoporous membrane.
This project studies how the thickness and defects of two-dimensional crystal materials change how well they store charge.
This project studies how duplicating the whole genome changes the way gray treefrogs control their hormones.
This project builds 3D scene models from multiple images that can be used to count and measure things.
This project builds a test strip and a handheld reader that detect the virus causing COVID-19 through its RNA and antigen.
This project studies how microscopic invertebrates called monogonont rotifers evolved to tolerate changing salinity.
This project develops wireless technology that keeps unmanned aerial vehicles connected and tests it in real outdoor flights.
This project combines machine learning with mathematical models to study how the chikungunya virus spreads through mosquito bites.
This project builds computing machines in hardware that use the memory of physical systems to solve hard computational problems.
This project studies how changes in gene activity affect the way light interacts with tissue, and builds AI methods to link them.
This project builds a deep learning model that models protein secondary structures from medium-resolution cryo-electron microscopy images.
